attempts.summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as a router between lan-a (node2, eth1) and lan-b (node3, eth1). Assigned static subnets 10.60.10.0/24 (lan-a) and 10.60.20.0/24 (lan-b) on node1's eth1/eth2, enabled IPv4 forwarding, and set a default-accept forward filter (no NAT, so source addresses are preserved). Configured static IPs and peer-subnet routes on node2 and node3 via nmcli. Verified ICMP and TCP (arbitrary port 5201) connectivity between node2 and node3 with tcpdump proof that node2's real source address (10.60.10.11) arrives unmodified at node3's LAN. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and health on all three nodes, sequentially rebooted node1, then node2, then node3 (one at a time), polled each until it returned, proved a changed boot_id on each, and re-verified config persistence and lan-a↔lan-b connectivity after each restart.
